description: A lab-local reentrancy: the vault updates the balance after the external call, so a recursive withdraw drains it.

evidence.request: lab-tx: withdraw(1) from reentrant lab contract
evidence.notes: Call trace: withdraw -> fallback -> withdraw -> fallback -> withdraw; balance updated only after the external call returns

impact: An attacker contract could drain the lab vault before its balance is updated.
proof_of_concept: Calling withdraw(1) from a lab contract whose fallback re-enters withdraw(1) drains 3 lab units in one transaction; the call trace shows withdraw -> fallback -> withdraw -> fallback -> withdraw.
remediation: Update the balance before the external call (checks-effects-interactions) or add a reentrancy guard.
steps_to_reproduce: Observe 3 lab units transferred in one transaction
title: Reentrancy in lab vault withdraw
